Hymn 157: Thy Spirit, Lord, Has Stirred Our Souls
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: C Major
Composer: Gaylen Hatton
Lyricist/Text Author: Frank I. Kooyman
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 157 titled "Thy Spirit, Lord, Has Stirred Our Souls" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in C Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Gaylen Hatton and the lyrics were written by Frank I. Kooyman.
This hymn is categorized under: Special Topics.
